prompt:
The image banner section in sections/image-banner-slides.liquid currently outputs a slide for every block. It does this even when a block has no image, and it ignores the maximum-slides setting. Change the markup to follow the rules below. Keep the {% schema %} block exactly as it is. Inputs. Every input is under `section`: - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.max_slides: integer from 1 to 5, or null. Null means 3. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each block has block.settings.image_url (string or null) and block.settings.caption (string or null). Rules: 1. Skipping. Process blocks in order. The URL of a block is its image_url with leading and trailing whitespace stripped. If the URL is null or empty after stripping, skip the block entirely. A skipped block does not produce a slide and does not count toward the limit. 2. Limit. Render at most max_slides slides. The limit counts only rendered slides, so skipped blocks before or between valid ones must not reduce the number of slides shown. Ignore any further valid blocks once the limit is reached. 3. Slide markup. Each rendered slide is `
CAPTION
`: - N is the 1-based position among rendered slides only (1, 2, 3...), regardless of how many blocks were skipped. - URL is the stripped URL, HTML-escaped. - CAPTION is `

TEXT

`, where TEXT is the stripped caption, HTML-escaped. - If the caption is null or empty after stripping, CAPTION is omitted entirely. 4. Wrapper. If at least one slide is rendered, output `
`, then the optional heading, then all slides in order, then `
`. The optional heading is `

HEADING

`, with the heading stripped and HTML-escaped. It is output only when section.settings.heading is non-null and non-empty after stripping. 5. No slides. If no slide is rendered, the section outputs nothing at all: no wrapper and no heading. This applies when there are no blocks or when every block is skipped. Formatting. Output no whitespace or newlines between tags. Leading and trailing whitespace of the whole output is ignored. HTML-escaping means the standard Liquid escape of & < > " characters. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/image-banner-slides.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
